text:
Alex Patel: Hey team — quick q about the onboarding schedule: the calendar invite shows 30m before and after each session (buffer). Is that intentional? I just got two invites for the same session because my calendar is set to UTC and my comp set to PST. Kinda confusing.
María Gómez: Hey @Alex — yes the buffers are deliberate (setup & cooldown). They help with regional handoffs. Sorry about the duplicate — looks like the org calendar exported both the floating event and a region-specific one.
Alex Patel: Got it. Any easy way to hide the duplicate?
María Gómez: If you go to the event details there should be an "Add to calendar" ICS and a note: use the event with suffix "(local)". We messed up the summary for a subset of invites tho — fixing source.
Tony Chen: Also wondering where recordings land? The invite mentions "recording available after" but doesn't say where. I won't have drive access for a few days.
María Gómez: Recordings are uploaded to the onboarding S3 bucket and we post a pre-signed link in the #new-hires thread after processing. We also attach the link to the event notes. If you don't see it, PM me. :slightly_smiling_face:
Alex Patel: Nice — do those links expire? I'm on APAC and might not be able to watch same day.
María Gómez: Presigned links expire in 7 days. For longer-term access we put a copy in the onboarding Google Drive (view-only) after quality checks — that copy can take 24–48h.
Tony Chen: OK thanks. Is there a way to get notified when the GDrive copy is ready?
Onboard Bot: @channel New hire session recordings: pre-signed S3 links posted in this channel within ~30m. GDrive archival expected within 48h.
Alex Patel: Sweet. One more: Zoom passcode to view the cloud recording? I clicked the cloud recording link once and it asked for passcode.
Lisa Brown: Hi @Alex — passcodes are embedded in the pre-signed S3 link flow. If you're redirected to Zoom and it requests a passcode, that means the org's cloud recording was set to "require passcode" before we moved it to S3. If you get prompted, reply here and I'll generate a temporary passcode.
Tony Chen: Any recommended calendar settings so my client doesn't double-schedule?
María Gómez: Two tips: 1) Set your calendar display timezone to your primary timezone (Google: Settings > Time zone > Display secondary time zone only). 2) Accept the event that has the suffix "(local)" and decline the other copy. We're pushing a cleanup soon.
Alex Patel: Thanks. For future new hires can the ICS include a link to the expected recording location (S3/GDrive)? saves a follow-up.
María Gómez: Agree. I'll add that to the onboarding checklist. For now, if you need the S3 link and can't find it, DM me or @Lisa Brown and we'll surface it.
Tony Chen: If helpful, here's a tiny curl to fetch a presigned link once posted (replace TOKEN):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" https://internal-onboard.example.com/recordings/1990
```
Lisa Brown: FYI if you need early access to the raw recording we can temporarily share a pre-signed URL with a longer expiry; this requires an IT ticket. Ping me and I'll open it.
Alex Patel: Perfect. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
María Gómez: Welcome again @Alex and @Tony. We'll follow up in this thread when the cleanup is deployed (should be this week).
